content.thinking:
Progress! The foreign-image acceptance test passed. Now the negative test 'caps-same' fails: I set capacities to [10^9]*4 which happens to equal the original caps. Let me change that mutation to something definitely different (e.g., halve one capacity so it becomes infeasible).

Let me fix: `setk(im,'capacities',[1,1,1,1])` → that would make it infeasible → invalid. Good.

Let me also double check the other mutations are meaningful. Let me update and re-run.

arguments.command:
cd /app/tmp && python3 - <<'EOF'
s=open('t_image.py').read()
s=s.replace("m(lambda im: setk(im,'capacities',[10**9]*3), 'caps-len')",
            "m(lambda im: setk(im,'capacities',[10**9]*3), 'caps-len')")
s=s.replace("m(lambda im: setk(im,'capacities',[10**9,10**9,10**9,10**9]), 'caps-same')",
            "m(lambda im: setk(im,'capacities',[1,10**9,10**9,10**9]), 'caps-small')")
open('t_image.py','w').write(s)
EOF
cd /app/tmp && timeout 110 python3 -u t_image.py 5 > out.log 2>&1; echo "rc=$?"; tail -6 out.log
